text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaahn, Heart-chan... Didn't I do sooo well 
today...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's my birthday, I didn't 
oversleep~, and even though it's my 
birthday, I even studied~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"What a champ! I'm so proud to have a 
roommate who doesn't slack off, even on a 
special day like this♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahn, compliments are nice, but~ Read 
between the lines a bit more~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way. Too tired. Carry me. ...All~ the~ 
way~ to~ my~ room~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Whoever secretly ate that whole bucket of 
ice cream yesterday needs to burn off 
those calories properly♪ Got that, cutie? 
♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Gah! H-How did you figure it out~!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I was observing you. After all, I 
want you to enjoy the present without any 
reservations.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It should be arriving in your room any 
moment now♪ Sprinkled with raspberries and 
strawberries, it's an utterly sweet...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A birthday cake for me?! You actually got 
one?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm performing~♡ I wuv you, 
Heart-chan~♡
